user.title: Add a grow system
user.description: A grow system is one set of devices that follows one grow plan at a time — for example a single hydroponic tower.

data_description.devices: Switches, lights, fans or input booleans the grow plan should drive (lights, pump, …).
data_description.ph_sensor: Optional. Leave empty to log pH readings by hand.
data_description.ec_sensor: Optional. Leave empty to log EC readings by hand.

device_names.title: Name your devices
device_names.description: Give each device a short name as it should appear in plans, e.g. "Side lights" or "Water pump".

abort.already_configured: A grow system with this name already exists.

data_description.ph_tolerance: pH is flagged when it drifts further than this from the plan's target.
data_description.ec_tolerance: EC is flagged when it drifts further than this from the stage's target.
data_description.reading_interval_days: A manual reading is flagged overdue after this many days.
data_description.reminder_time: When the daily "tasks due" event fires.
data_description.auto_advance: Move to the next stage at midnight once a stage's estimated days have passed. When off, stages only change when you advance them.

data_description.ph_sensor: Leave empty to log pH readings by hand.
data_description.ec_sensor: Leave empty to log EC readings by hand.

add_devices.title: Add devices
add_devices.description: New devices are left alone by existing plans until you give them a schedule in each stage.

rename_device.title: Rename or re-point a device
rename_device.description: Schedules in your plans follow the device, so you can swap the underlying entity without editing any plan.

remove_device.title: Remove devices
remove_device.description: Removed devices are no longer switched. Their schedules stay in your plans but are ignored.

error.no_new_devices: All selected devices are already part of this system.

data_description.preset: Presets fill in stages and device schedules. You can change everything afterwards.

map_roles.title: Match the preset to your devices
map_roles.description: The preset has schedules for these roles. Pick which of your devices plays each one, or "—" to leave it out.

data_description.target_ph: Optional. Used to flag readings that drift out of range.

data_description.days: Used for progress and the expected harvest date.
data_description.target_ec: Optional. Used to flag readings that drift out of range.
data_description.outcome: What the plants should look like by the end of this stage.

stage_schedule.title: {stage}: {device} ({position}/{count})
stage_schedule.description:
How should **{device}** (`{entity_id}`) behave during this stage?

- **Time window** uses on/off time (windows may cross midnight).
- **Interval** uses on-for / every, repeating from midnight.
- **Not managed** leaves the device alone.

data_description.day: Day 1 is the day the stage starts.
Day 1 is the day the stage starts.

error.name_taken: Another plan already uses this name.
error.window_required: Set both an on time and an off time.
error.window_empty: On and off times must differ.
error.interval_required: Set both how long the device runs and how often.
